text.tspan: MAIN WIRING · one controller at the centre · one conductor per route
Selected controller build: follow each named terminal and match every route ID to the evidence list below.
DOTTED = GUESS / proposed wire; verify before connecting
OPEN = no connection until the missing evidence is obtained
Crossing lines are not junctions. Only named terminal circles are connection points. Repeated controller labels are contact references, not extra physical pins.
Selected machine retrofit · individual contact references

g.title: C01-001 · SmoothieBox 5 V power · Verify exact board supply path and rail ratings; motor current uses separate wiring and fuses.
C01-002 · SmoothieBox supply return · Verify exact board supply path and rail ratings; motor current uses separate wiring and fuses.
C02-001 · SmoothieBox STEP to line-driver input · Channel-to-axis mapping proposed. Confirm Smoothieware motion channel assignment and pulse timing.
C02-002 · SmoothieBox DIR to line-driver input · Direction polarity/edge semantics require configuration and disabled/uncoupled bench test.
C02-003 · SmoothieBox 3.3 V to AM26LV31E pin16 · TI allows 3.3 V supply; verify current budget for two ICs. Add local 0.1µF bypass from pin16 to pin8.
C02-004 · SmoothieBox GND to AM26LV31E pin8 · Use board-source ground contacts; this is non-isolated and should be reviewed for ground/noise.
C02-005 · Enable input pin4 G high · Drive both controls to asserted state: G high, /G low. Add defined states so power-up cannot leave outputs floating.
C02-006 · Active-low enable pin12 /G low · Confirm correct powered/disabled startup behavior before connecting servo.
C02-007 · AM26LV31E channel 1 Y output to PULSE+ · B3A-L manual section 3.10.1 accepts differential line-driver input. Validate pair polarity/mode with exact drive and bench test.
C02-008 · AM26LV31E channel 1 Z output to PULSE− · Use twisted pair; exact cable/termination must match drive manual.
C02-009 · AM26LV31E channel 2 Y output to SIGN+ · Validate commanded positive direction under uncoupled/disabled commissioning.
C02-010 · AM26LV31E channel 2 Z output to SIGN− · Use twisted pair; no 24V on differential signal pins.
C02-011 · DIR GND separate reference conductor · Proposed separate field-ground wire to verified receiver/interface reference. Do not use motor power return as an assumed signal reference.

C12-001 · Home/probe x input contract · Owner reports homing-switch damage and names ABB SSR10 safety relay, Schneider contactors, coolant, mist, operator buttons and TouchDRO. No complete sensor/IO terminal map is supplied. Powered proximity sensors require rated supply and matched NPN/PNP isolation/conditioning; dry-contact wiring cannot be assumed. Retain independent safety/drive-ready latch and matched power circuits.
